64: def fnmatchcase(name, pat):
65:     """Test whether FILENAME matches PATTERN, including case.
66: 
67:     This is a version of fnmatch() which doesn't case-normalize
68:     its arguments.
69:     """
70:     match = _compile_pattern(pat)
71:     return match(name) is not None

74: def translate(pat, sep=None):
75:     """Translate a shell PATTERN to a regular expression.
76: 
77:     A path separator character may be supplied to the *sep* argument. If
78:     given, '*' and '?' wildcards will not match separators; '*' wildcards in
79:     standalone pattern segments match precisely one path segment; and  '**'
80:     wildcards in standalone segments match any number of path segments.
81: 
82:     There is no way to quote meta-characters.
83:     """
84:     if sep:
85:         res = _translate_path(pat, sep)
86:     else:
87:         res = _translate(pat)
88:     return fr'(?s:{res})\Z'

91: def _translate_bracket(pat, i, n, DOT):
92:     """Translate a '[...]' character set starting at index *i* (just after the
93:     opening '['). Returns the regular expression fragment and the index of the
94:     first character after the set.
95:     """
96:     j = i
97:     if j < n and pat[j] == '!':
98:         j = j+1
99:     if j < n and pat[j] == ']':
100:         j = j+1
101:     while j < n and pat[j] != ']':
102:         j = j+1
103:     if j >= n:
104:         return '\\[', i
